cues.en: Thank you to Brilliant for supporting PBS Digital Studios.
cues.zh: 感谢 Brilliant 对 PBS Digital Studios 的支持。

cues.en: Conservation laws are among the most important tools in physics. They feel as fundamental as you can get, and yet they're wrong, or at least they're only right sometimes.
cues.zh: 守恒定律是物理学中最重要的工具之一。它们看似极其根本，但其实并不完全正确，或者说，它们并非时刻成立。

cues.en: These laws are consequences of a much deeper,
cues.zh: 这些定律其实源于一个更深层、

cues.en: more fundamental principle,
cues.zh: 更根本的原理——

cues.en: Noether's theorem.
cues.zh: Noether 定理。

cues.en: Conservation laws are the cheat codes of physics. They make it possible to solve physics problems that would otherwise be painfully difficult or even impossible.
cues.zh: 守恒定律就像是物理学中的作弊码。它让解决物理问题成为可能，否则这些问题会极其棘手、甚至根本无法解决。

cues.en: More than cheat codes, conservation laws are close to the source code.
cues.zh: 比起作弊码，守恒定律其实更接近源代码。

cues.en: They emerge from profound and simple truths about the basis of reality.
cues.zh: 它们源于构成现实根基的那些深刻而纯粹的真理。

cues.en: They emerge from the fundamental symmetries of nature.
cues.zh: 它们源于自然界的基本对称性。

cues.en: The connection between conservation laws and symmetry is encapsulated
cues.zh: 守恒定律与对称性之间的深刻联系，

cues.en: in Noether's theorem. But before we dive into this extremely elegant idea, let's talk about the seeming paradox that inspired it and genius who discovered it. When it was published in 1915, Einstein's general theory of relativity opened as many questions as it answered.
cues.zh: 全都凝聚在 Noether 定理中。但在深入探讨这个精巧绝伦的理论之前，我们先来聊聊启发它的佯谬，以及发现它的那位天才。1915 年 Einstein 发表广义相对论时，它引发的新问题几乎和它解决的问题一样多。

cues.en: Among them is the fact that energy is not always conserved in general relativity.
cues.zh: 其中一个事实就是：在广义相对论中，能量并不总是守恒的。

cues.en: The simplest example of this is the case of cosmological redshift.
cues.zh: 最简单的例子就是宇宙学红移。

cues.en: As the universe expands, light traveling through that expanding space is stretched out. Its wavelength
cues.zh: 随着宇宙膨胀，穿行在膨胀空间中的光被拉长。它的波长

cues.en: increases,
cues.zh: 增加了，

cues.en: and so the energy of each photon drops.
cues.zh: 因此每个光子的能量也随之下降。

cues.en: Where does the energy from red shifted photons go?
cues.zh: 红移光子的能量去了哪里？

cues.en: the expansion of the universe hadn't yet been discovered, but the failure of energy conservation
cues.zh: 宇宙膨胀尚未被发现，但能量守恒的失效

cues.en: was still clear from the math of general relativity.
cues.zh: 从广义相对论的数学中仍然很清楚。

cues.en: Two of the greats of the era, David Hilbert and Felix Klein, sought the help of a young mathematician,
cues.zh: 那个时代的两位巨匠，David Hilbert 和 Felix Klein，向一位年轻数学家求助，

cues.en: Emmy Noether, to understand this seeming paradox.
cues.zh: Emmy Noether，来理解这个看似矛盾的现象。

cues.en: She discovered
cues.zh: 她发现了

cues.en: why the law of conservation of energy broke down in general relativity.
cues.zh: 为什么能量守恒定律在广义相对论中失效。

cues.en: The law was not fundamental after all. She realized that all conservation laws arise from a more fundamental relationship,
cues.zh: 这条定律终究不是基本的。她意识到，所有守恒定律都源于一种更基本的关系，

cues.en: which we call Noether's theorem.
cues.zh: 我们称之为 Noether 定理。

cues.en: A simple expression of Noether's theorem is this.
cues.zh: Noether 定理的一个简单表述是这样的。

cues.en: For every continuous symmetry of the universe, there exists a conserved quantity.
cues.zh: 对于宇宙的每一个连续对称性，都存在一个守恒量。

cues.en: Let's unpack this. First, what do we mean by symmetry?
cues.zh: 我们来拆解一下。首先，对称是什么意思？

cues.en: Actually, first, what don't we mean? We say a face is symmetric if it looks the same under a mirror reflection.
cues.zh: 其实，先说说我们不指什么？如果一张脸在镜面反射下看起来一样，我们就说它是对称的。

cues.en: Snowflakes are symmetric under 60 degree rotation.
cues.zh: 雪花在 60 度旋转下是对称的。

cues.en: Playing cars under one eighty degree rotation.
cues.zh: 扑克牌在 180 度旋转下也一样。

cues.en: But these are what we call discrete symmetries,
cues.zh: 但这些是我们所说的离散对称性，

cues.en: single flips around one axis or rotation by specific amounts.
cues.zh: 绕单一轴翻转，或按特定角度旋转。

cues.en: Noether's theorem applies to continuous symmetries.
cues.zh: Noether 定理适用于连续对称性。

cues.en: Something is continuously symmetric if it stays the same for any size shift in a given coordinate.
cues.zh: 如果某物在给定坐标中任意大小的平移下都保持不变，它就是连续对称的。

cues.en: For example, a long road in the middle of nowhere is continuously symmetric under spatial translations
cues.zh: 例如，荒郊野外的一条长路在空间平移下是连续对称的

cues.en: in the direction of the road. A perfect sphere is continuously symmetric under rotational translations.
cues.zh: 沿道路方向。一个完美球体在旋转平移下是连续对称的。

cues.en: In both cases, the environment stays the same for shifts along the symmetric coordinate.
cues.zh: 在两种情况下，沿对称坐标移动时，环境保持不变。

cues.en: In the case of Noether's theorem, when we say the environment stays the same, we mean the equations that give the laws of motion for the system.
cues.zh: 在诺特定理的情形中，当我们说环境保持不变，指的是给出系统运动定律的方程。

cues.en: For example, moving along a perfectly flat road, the downward force of gravity stays constant. We have symmetry to spatial translation,
cues.zh: 例如，在完全平坦的道路上行驶，向下的重力保持不变。我们具有空间平移对称性，

cues.en: and Notice theorem tells us there's a corresponding conserved quantity.
cues.zh: 诺特定理告诉我们，存在一个对应的守恒量。

cues.en: That quantity is momentum.
cues.zh: 这个量就是动量。

cues.en: If two cars collide on that road, the sum of their combined momentum stays the same. But what if the road is hilly?
cues.zh: 如果两辆车在那条路上相撞，它们合并后的动量总和保持不变。但如果道路起伏不平呢？

cues.en: Momentum doesn't appear to be conserved. It can be lost or gained to the gravitational field.
cues.zh: 动量似乎不守恒了。它可以丢失给引力场，或从引力场获得。

cues.en: This is because the direction of the gravitational field changes with respect to the road. It's not symmetric to translations along the road. On the other hand, the gravitational field across the whole stretch of road doesn't change from one point in time to the next. The system is symmetric to time translations.
cues.zh: 这是因为引力场的方向相对于道路发生了变化。它不具有沿道路平移的对称性。另一方面，整段道路上的引力场从一个时刻到下一个时刻不发生变化。该系统具有时间平移对称性。

cues.en: It doesn't matter when the collision happens. The results are the same.
cues.zh: 碰撞何时发生无关紧要。结果是一样的。

cues.en: Notice theorem reveals that this time translation symmetry gives us energy conservation.
cues.zh: 诺特定理揭示，这种时间平移对称性给我们带来了能量守恒。

cues.en: And the last classic example.
cues.zh: 最后一个经典例子。

cues.en: If the factors driving the laws of motion are symmetric under rotation, for example, the spherically symmetric gravitational field experienced by a satellite orbiting the Earth, then Noether's theorem predicts another conserved quantity, angular momentum.
cues.zh: 如果驱动运动定律的因素在旋转下是对称的，例如，绕地球运行的卫星所经历的球对称引力场，那么诺特定理预测了另一个守恒量——角动量。

cues.en: By revealing the underlying source of conservation laws, Noether's theorem handily explains when and why they're broken.
cues.zh: 通过揭示守恒定律的根本来源，Noether 定理轻松解释了它们何时以及为何会被打破。

cues.en: That includes the apparent breaking of conservation of energy in general relativity.
cues.zh: 这其中就包括广义相对论中能量守恒看似被打破的情况。

cues.en: See, Einstein's description of gravity reveals the dimensions of space and time to be dynamic and changeable.
cues.zh: 你看，爱因斯坦对引力的描述揭示了时空维度是动态且可变的。

cues.en: If the very nature of space can change over time, then continuous
cues.zh: 如果空间本身的性质会随时间改变，那么连续的

cues.en: time symmetry is broken.
cues.zh: 时间对称性就会被打破。

cues.en: That's the case with the expanding universe.
cues.zh: 膨胀的宇宙正是这种情况。

cues.en: Energy
cues.zh: 能量

cues.en: can be lost in the case of cosmological redshift, and it can be created from nowhere in the case of dark energy.
cues.zh: 在宇宙学红移中可能会平白损失，在暗能量的情况下又可能凭空产生。

cues.en: The law of conservation of energy is fundamental in Newtonian mechanics
cues.zh: 能量守恒定律在牛顿力学中是一条基本法则，

cues.en: in which space and time are invariant and eternal.
cues.zh: 在那里，空间和时间是恒定且永恒的。

cues.en: But in Einstein's universe, energy conservation is only valid as a special case.
cues.zh: 但在爱因斯坦的宇宙中，能量守恒仅在特例下才成立。

cues.en: It only applies for parts of the universe where we can approximate space as unchanging over time.
cues.zh: 它只适用于宇宙中那些我们可以将空间近似视为不随时间变化的部分。

cues.en: However, it's possible to use Noether's theorem to come up with an analogous quantity that is conserved.
cues.zh: 不过，我们可以利用 Noether 定理推导出一个类似的守恒量。

cues.en: That quantity
cues.zh: 这个量

cues.en: is the rather esoteric
cues.zh: 就是相当深奥的

cues.en: Landau Lifshitz
cues.zh: Landau Lifshitz

cues.en: pseudotensor.
cues.zh: 赝张量。

cues.en: It saves energy conservation
cues.zh: 它挽救了能量守恒定律，

cues.en: by incorporating
cues.zh: 方式是将

cues.en: the entire universe's
cues.zh: 整个宇宙的

cues.en: gravitational potential energy to offset the seeming gains or losses to redshift and dark energy.
cues.zh: 引力势能纳入考量，以此抵消红移和暗能量看似带来的能量增减。

cues.en: This quantity is, however, controversial
cues.zh: 然而，这个物理量本身存在很大争议，

cues.en: in its application and in its interpretation.
cues.zh: 无论是在其实际应用还是物理诠释上。

cues.en: It's also worth an entire episode, so I'll leave it alone for now.
cues.zh: 它本身就值得单做一期视频细讲，所以今天咱们就先不展开了。

cues.en: Despite its profound implications,
cues.zh: 尽管其意义深远，

cues.en: the math behind Noether's theorem is surprisingly straightforward.
cues.zh: 诺特定式背后的数学却出奇地简单。

cues.en: It falls like magic out of another deep law of the universe,
cues.zh: 它像魔法一样源自宇宙的另一条深层定律，

cues.en: the principle of least action,
cues.zh: 即最小作用量原理，

cues.en: which states that the universe will always choose the path between two states that minimizes the change in the action.
cues.zh: 该原理指出，宇宙总是选择两个状态之间作用量变化最小的那条路径。

cues.en: This is a rather abstract quantity that measures the effort involved in moving between two states over some time interval. It's a generalization of Fermat's principle, which states that light will always take the path between two points that minimizes the travel time. The principle of least action extends Fermat's principle to any object moving on any path or indeed any system, quantum mechanical to cosmological,
cues.zh: 这是一个相当抽象的量，衡量在某个时间区间内从一状态移动到另一状态所涉及的“努力”。它是费马原理的推广，费马原理指出光总是选择两点之间传播时间最短的路径。最小作用量原理将费马原理推广到任何沿任意路径运动的物体，乃至任何系统——从量子力学到宇宙学，

cues.en: evolving between two states.
cues.zh: 在两个状态之间演化。

cues.en: The principle of least action can be used to derive the laws of motion from the equations of classical mechanics to Feynman's path integral formulation of quantum mechanics.
cues.zh: 最小作用量原理可用于推导运动定律，从经典力学的方程到费曼的量子力学路径积分表述。

cues.en: In a sense, the principle is axiomatic.
cues.zh: 某种意义上，这条原理是公理性的。

cues.en: It's a founding assumption behind these derivations,
cues.zh: 它是这些推导背后的基础假设，

cues.en: and it's also the founding assumption behind Noether's theorem. However, as a founding assumption,
cues.zh: 也是诺特定理背后的基础假设。然而，作为一条基础假设，

cues.en: that is as close to as fundamental as we can get.
cues.zh: 这已经是我们能触及的最接近根本的层次了。

cues.en: Noether's theorem allows us to figure out the true conserved quantities for any system that's evolving according to the principle of least action,
cues.zh: 诺特定理让我们能够找出任何按照最小作用量原理演化的系统的真正守恒量，

cues.en: as long as we can identify that system's symmetries.
cues.zh: 只要我们能够识别出该系统的对称性。

cues.en: This is useful in cosmology, but it's also useful in quantum physics.
cues.zh: 这在宇宙学中很有用，但在量子物理中同样有用。

cues.en: The general nature of the theorem means we can apply it to not just the symmetries in the dimensions of space and time, but also to more abstract coordinates.
cues.zh: 该定理的普适性意味着，我们不仅能将其应用于时空维度的对称性，还能应用于更抽象的坐标。

cues.en: For example, another conserved quantity in physics is electric charge.
cues.zh: 比如，物理学中另一个守恒量就是电荷。

cues.en: Notice theorem tells us that there should be a corresponding symmetry of nature,
cues.zh: 诺特定理告诉我们，自然界中应该存在一个对应的对称性，

cues.en: and there is.
cues.zh: 事实也确实如此。

cues.en: That symmetry is the phase of the quantum field. You can rotate the complex phase of an oscillation in a quantum field by any amount, and the observable properties of that field, like its particles,
cues.zh: 这种对称性就是量子场的相位。你可以任意旋转量子场振荡的复相位，而该场的可观测性质（比如它的粒子），

cues.en: don't change. This symmetry leads to the conservation of electric charge and electric current.
cues.zh: 都不会改变。这种对称性导致了电荷与电流的守恒。

cues.en: This quantum symmetry is just the simplest of a large number of symmetries exhibited by quantum fields,
cues.zh: 这种量子对称性，仅仅是量子场展现出的众多对称性中最简单的一种，

cues.en: the so called gauge symmetries.
cues.zh: 也就是所谓的规范对称性。

cues.en: They predict a rich family of conserved charges that govern the interactions of the particles of the standard model. For example, the color charge of quantum chromodynamics
cues.zh: 它们预言了极其丰富的守恒荷，支配着标准模型中粒子的相互作用。例如，量子色动力学中的色荷，

cues.en: describes the strong interaction between quarks and gluons.
cues.zh: 就描述了夸克与胶子之间的强相互作用。

cues.en: The entire standard model of particle physics is what we call a gauge theory.
cues.zh: 整个粒子物理标准模型就是一种规范理论。

cues.en: It's founded on the fundamental symmetries of quantum fields.
cues.zh: 它建立在量子场的基本对称性之上。

cues.en: It's gonna take a few episodes to explain exactly what these symmetries really are and how they lead to the family of particles and interactions that make up our universe,
cues.zh: 要彻底讲清这些对称性究竟是什么，以及它们如何引出构成我们宇宙的粒子家族与相互作用，需要花上几期视频的篇幅，

cues.en: and we'll jump into that before too long.
cues.zh: 我们很快就会深入探讨这一主题。

cues.en: Emmy Nota was one of the greatest mathematicians of the golden age of modern physics,
cues.zh: Emmy Nota 是现代物理学黄金时代最伟大的数学家之一，

cues.en: yet she gained little public recognition in her time and is still only known to the more eager students of math and physics.
cues.zh: 但她在生前鲜为人知，如今也只有格外求知若渴的数学和物理学生才晓得她。

cues.en: During her life, she was repeatedly refused any paid academic position due to her gender until late in her career.
cues.zh: 在她的一生中，仅因性别原因，她屡次被拒于有薪学术职位之外，直到职业生涯晚期才有所改变。

cues.en: Hermann Weil, also a giant in the mathematical foundation of quantum mechanics, said in her memorial address,
cues.zh: 同样是量子力学数学基础奠基巨擘的 Hermann Weil，在她的悼词中说道：

cues.en: I was ashamed to occupy such a preferred position beside her whom I knew to be my superior as a mathematician
cues.zh: “坐在她身旁享有如此优越的职位让我深感惭愧，因为我知道作为数学家，

cues.en: in many respects.
cues.zh: 她在许多方面都远胜于我。”

cues.en: Einstein also called her a genius.
cues.zh: Einstein 也曾称她为天才。

cues.en: Her contributions to mathematics,
cues.zh: 她对数学的贡献，

cues.en: particularly abstract algebra, redefined entire fields.
cues.zh: 尤其是抽象代数，重新定义了整个领域。

cues.en: Let's be thankful that she took a moment to offer a little of her genius to physics,
cues.zh: 我们真该庆幸，她曾抽空向物理学展现了自己的一点天才智慧，

cues.en: taking us a big step closer to understanding the fundamental workings of the universe
cues.zh: 让我们在理解宇宙基本运作机制上迈出了一大步——

cues.en: through the continuous symmetries
cues.zh: 借助连续的

cues.en: of space time.
cues.zh: 时空对称性。

cues.en: And this week, an extra huge shout out to Big Bang supporter Fabrice Erpp. Fabrice, your continuously time symmetric contributions are fundamental to the conservation
cues.zh: 本周还要特别感谢 Big Bang 级别的赞助者 Fabrice Erpp。Fabrice，你在时间上连续对称的贡献，对于

cues.en: of space time, So thank you.
cues.zh: 时空的守恒至关重要，非常感谢！

cues.en: Last week, we talked about the incredible wealth of data dropped by the Gaia mission.
cues.zh: 上周，我们讲了 Gaia 任务带来的海量宝贵数据。

cues.en: You guys had a ton to say. Super user asks how Gaia compares to the upcoming LSST.
cues.zh: 大家提出了很多问题。Super user 问 Gaia 与即将开展的 LSST 相比如何。

cues.en: So the Large Synoptic Survey Telescope will indeed be revolutionary.
cues.zh: 大型巡天望远镜确实将带来革命性的变化。

cues.en: It does have some overlap with Gaia in that it'll measure light curves, so changes in brightness over time for billions of objects across the entire sky.
cues.zh: 它与 Gaia 有一些重叠之处：都会测量光变曲线，也就是整个天空中数十亿个天体的亮度随时间的变化。

cues.en: But Gaia is really optimized for extreme astrometry,
cues.zh: 但 Gaia 真正针对的是极高精度的天体测量，

cues.en: phenomenally accurate position data that actually allows measurements of velocities.
cues.zh: 它能提供极其精确的位置数据，甚至可以据此测量速度。

cues.en: LSST won't do as well in that regard, in part because it's on the ground in the Atacama Andes in Chile rather than in space. But LSST will see much further and fainter than Gaia. It has a 35 square meter collecting area compared to Gaia's 0.7 square meters. It'll find more small solar system objects, detect the effects of weak gravitational lensing in distant galaxies, and see more distant supernovae,
cues.zh: 在这方面，LSST 的表现不会那么好，部分原因是它位于智利的阿塔卡马安第斯山脉地面上，而不是太空中。不过，LSST 能看到比 Gaia 更远、更暗的天体。它的集光面积为 35 平方米，而 Gaia 只有 0.7 平方米。它会发现更多小型太阳系天体，探测遥远星系中弱引力透镜的效应，还能看到距离更远的超新星，

cues.en: monitoring more distant quasars for their flickering. In general, it'll do better in what we call the time domain by scanning the entire sky every few nights, and it'll keep coming back and back and back to measure changing brightnesses at high time resolution over ten years.
cues.zh: 并监测更遥远类星体的闪烁。总体来说，它在我们所谓的时间域方面会表现得更好：每隔几晚扫描整个天空一次，并在十年间不断重复观测，以很高的时间分辨率测量亮度变化。

cues.en: Simon Clarkstone asked how Gaia can take such precise measurements. Surely, its camera doesn't have pixels this small. It's good insight, Simon. Gaia's precision is plus or minus point three milliarc seconds.
cues.zh: Simon Clarkstone 问 Gaia 是如何进行如此精确的测量的。按理说，它的相机不可能拥有这么小的像素。Simon，这个问题问得很好。Gaia 的精度是正负 0.3 毫角秒。

cues.en: We mentioned, the width of a hair at a thousand kilometers.
cues.zh: 我们提到过，一千公里外一根头发的宽度。

cues.en: Yet its pixels are only 60
cues.zh: 但它的像素只有60

cues.en: on their shortest dimension.
cues.zh: 在最短维度上。

cues.en: It can do better than that off the bat by analyzing the way the light from each star spreads into neighboring pixels by fitting the so called point spread function.
cues.zh: 它一开始就能做得更好：通过拟合所谓的点扩散函数，分析每颗恒星的光如何扩散到相邻像素中。

cues.en: But its extreme precision is possible because it comes back to every field many times over the five years of its operation.
cues.zh: 但它能达到极高精度，是因为在五年运行期间，它会多次回到每个天区。

cues.en: Each time, stars will have moved slightly, but they'll have moved in extremely predictable ways. By fitting laws of motion to the star's five year trajectory,
cues.zh: 每次恒星都会稍微移动，但移动方式极其可预测。通过把运动定律拟合到恒星的五年轨迹上，

cues.en: there's only a very narrow trajectory of extremely precise locations
cues.zh: 只有一条非常窄的、由极精确位置构成的轨迹

cues.en: that ends up working. Nebularium
cues.zh: 最终才可行。Nebularium

cues.en: asks whether white dwarfs is the correct plural rather than white dwarves with a v.
cues.zh: 问的是正确复数到底是 white dwarfs，而不是带 v 的 white dwarves。

cues.en: Well, to quote Tolkien's 1937 forward to The Hobbit, in English, the only correct plural of dwarf is dwarfs,
cues.zh: 好吧，引用托尔金1937年《霍比特人》前言的话，在英语中，dwarf 唯一正确的复数是 dwarfs，

cues.en: and the adjective is dwarf fish.
cues.zh: 而形容词是 dwarfish。

cues.en: In this story, dwarves and dwarvish are used, but only when speaking of the ancient people to whom Thorin Oakenshield and his companions belonged.
cues.zh: 在这个故事里，dwarves 和 dwarvish 会被使用，但只用于指索林·橡木盾及其同伴所属的古老族群。

cues.en: You could also check appendix f in Lord of the Rings. Seriously, people, on space time, we only ask that you start with a passing familiarity with quantum physics and the etymological foundations of the languages of Middle Earth. Please do your assigned readings.
cues.zh: 你也可以查看《指环王》的附录 F。说真的，各位，在 Space Time 上，我们只要求你对量子物理和中土世界各语言的词源基础有个初步了解。请完成指定阅读。
